findings.issue: Native evidence sampled endpoints after batches and queried logical poses/radii, not actual displayed bodies
findings.resolution: Sample actual pooled transforms/scales at fractions 0/.25/.5/.75/1 before every action; separately validate mapping; retain terminal counts; runtime sensitivity checks deliberately corrupt scale/pose and verify detection

findings.issue: Overload deadline exemption was inconsistent with positive-fixture acceptance
findings.resolution: Explicit expected-adverse overload classification and deadlineMet=false; seven ordinary fixtures retain the 240s criterion; 61 late overload IDs and maximum280s remain failed response evidence

findings.issue: Post-exit source hashes alone do not identify build-time source
findings.resolution: Build-time C# snapshot plus frozen source and assembly/buildGUID/process comparisons

followup: Reviewer reread corrected view/runner/editor/design and found no remaining actionable issues. Added native corruption sensitivity cases execute only in the test harness, outside measurements.
